evals.prompt: Migrate AntD Steps into this shadcn + Tailwind v4 project with 1:1 current public API and docs demo parity. Deprecated props should be identified and recorded as not migrated by default unless explicitly requested.
evals.expected_output: Selects profiles/antd.md, avoids unknown-library discovery, builds a compatibility contract with AntD source evidence, traces rc/shared behavior when applicable, maps style graph and docs demos, enforces Tailwind-first styling and no Ant runtime CSS leakage, and requires independent verifier evidence before completion.

assertions.text: Uses profiles/antd.md for AntD and records the profile decision in the contract.
Dispatches or requires ui_source_auditor, ui_style_graph_auditor, ui_demo_parity_auditor, ui_browser_geometry_verifier, ui_contract_closure_verifier, and ui_learning_promoter when their scopes apply.
Requires docs demo parity matrix rows for source demo fixtures and rejects synthetic demo parity.
Requires check-no-source-css with the AntD profile deny patterns and blocks target runtime ant-* or --ant-* styling.
Blocks Migration completed unless protected checklist rows have fresh-context independent verifier attribution.

evals.prompt: Migrate MUI Autocomplete into this shadcn + Tailwind v4 project. The skill currently has no built-in MUI profile.
evals.expected_output: Does not guess MUI APIs. Runs or requires ui_profile_builder to create a temporary profile with docs/package/source evidence, API extraction path, examples path, theme/token model, slot/style API, internal primitives, legacy policy, and runtime CSS deny patterns before planning implementation.

assertions.text: Records no known profile match and dispatches ui_profile_builder or an equivalent generic subagent before source/API planning.
Creates a temporary profile in the contract and records source docs/source/package versions.
Requires library discovery evidence before any implementation claim.
Defines MUI-specific runtime CSS deny patterns from profile discovery before running no-source-css checks.
Marks Migration blocked if profile discovery cannot establish API, demo, theme, slot/style, primitive, or deny-pattern evidence.

evals.prompt: Migrate Chakra Menu into this shadcn + Tailwind v4 project while preserving theme, slot, portal, keyboard, and focus behavior. No formal Chakra profile exists yet.
evals.expected_output: Builds a temporary Chakra profile first, records theme and recipe/token model, slot/style props, portal and positioning behavior, examples path, source CSS leakage deny patterns, then plans Radix/headless implementation with Tailwind-first styling and independent verifier evidence.

assertions.text: Dispatches ui_profile_builder and records a temporary profile with theme/token, slot/style, portal, and keyboard behavior evidence.
Classifies Menu as a Radix/headless behavior component only after verifying callback timing, focus order, portal, and stacking behavior.
Requires browser geometry verifier evidence for portal, z-index, focus, overflow, and viewer shell claims.
Requires source CSS leakage checks using Chakra profile deny patterns rather than AntD-specific patterns.

evals.prompt: Migrate FooUI MegaSelect into this shadcn + Tailwind v4 project. I only know the library name and component name.
evals.expected_output: Starts with profile auto-discovery. If source docs/package/source evidence cannot be found, reports Migration blocked instead of inventing APIs, demos, tokens, selectors, or behavior. If evidence is found, creates a temporary profile and proceeds through contract, tests, implementation, independent verification, and learning/profile closure.

assertions.text: Does not invent public API, props, events, slots, or style hooks.
Runs or requires ui_profile_builder before source/API auditor work.
Records Library discovery evidence and Profile decision before implementation.
Outputs Migration blocked when discovery cannot prove required profile fields.
Still requires independent verifier and no-source-css gates when migration proceeds.
